gen-gf-klee-one-fs-plein: Loose, friendly handwriting up top. Klee One has short-cut terminals and a thick-only outline that look best big and brief, while Plein follows in clean sans-serif, comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-klee-one-fs-rowan: Klee One writes with graceful, casual strokes that never change thickness, like bent wire. And Rowan, a serif with generous curve openings and modest thick-thin contrast, is the one to trust for a handful of lines.
gen-gf-klee-one-fs-synonym: Synonym reads as a clean, dependable sans, a constant stripe of ink with generous curve openings. And Klee One's cut-short terminals bring a casual handwritten feel, so a handful of lines in it can run larger.
gen-gf-konkhmer-sleokchher-fs-paquito: Paquito is confident and approachable, its serif caps nearly level with the lowercase. Konkhmer Sleokchher adds a commanding display voice above it, though this pairing isn't built for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-fs-amulya: Amulya looks contemporary and modern, with curve gaps that stay generous in its sans-serif build. But if Lakki Reddy, with its hand-drawn stencil-cut letters, gets shrunk down, its mild bar variation fades.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-fs-spline-sans: Relaxed and personal, Lakki Reddy has a soft, understated thickness change in its hand-drawn curves. Spline Sans follows in sans-serif, its curves never thinning at the turns, which suits brief copy best.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-lora: Lakki Reddy has a hand-drawn, relaxed feel with mild thick-thin variation, and it is best big and brief. Lora, a bookish serif with modest hairline thinning and a broad c, handles short stretches of reading.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-plus-jakarta-san: Liu Jian Mao Cao is a single-thickness brush trace, narrow and casual, with very little room around each letter. And Plus Jakarta Sans steps in as the modern, precise sans, its curve endings kept well apart.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-space-grotesk: Liu Jian Mao Cao is a relaxed, casual hand with narrow spacing, drawn at a single thickness throughout. Space Grotesk, geometric sans with open counters, gives a handful of lines a steady footing.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-stint-ul: Chunky, expressive and bold, Love Ya Like A Sister has ascenders that barely clear the x-height and outward-pointing terminal tips. Stint Ultra Expanded, authoritative and traditional, sets text that feels spaced out and slow.
